endpoints.name: Clemson Wind Turbine
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/1065459660 power=substation substation=industrial voltage=115000 (unnamed, start_date=2020), fed by 115 kV OSM line way/1065459659; about 250 m from 1240 Supply St (Nominatim 32.8551,-79.9597), North Charleston
endpoints.validation: clemson.edu gives the Dominion Energy Innovation Center (Clemson's wind-turbine drivetrain test facility, Building 69, former Navy Base) as 1240 Supply St, North Charleston. This unnamed 115 kV industrial substation is about 250 m from that address, which fits the plan's 115 kV line. OSM has no name tag, so the match is by location and voltage only.

endpoints.name: Coast Guard
endpoints.coordinateSource: Nominatim: OSM way/487069141 landuse=military 'U.S. Coast Guard - Base Charleston', North Charleston, Charleston County (site centroid, not a substation)
endpoints.validation: The plan names only 'the Coast Guard substation site'. Live 5 News (Jan 2024) places the new 64-acre Coast Guard Base Charleston campus at 4500 S Hobson Ave on the Cooper River, and Nominatim puts S Hobson Ave inside this polygon. It is about 1.6 km from the Clemson substation, which fits a short radial 115 kV line. No public source gives the exact substation position.

projects.notes: A = Clemson Wind Turbine, B = Coast Guard (new radial 115 kV line). Both are on the former Navy Base in North Charleston, Charleston County, within 2 km of each other.

endpoints.name: Dunbar Road
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/185400354 power=substation name=Dunbar Road Substation operator=South Carolina Gas & Electric voltage=115000
endpoints.validation: The name matches exactly. The operator is SCE&G (now DESC) and the voltage is 115 kV, as in the plan. It is in Cayce/West Columbia, Lexington County.

endpoints.name: Lyles
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/185230443 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000;115000;33000 (unnamed), about 0.7 km from Lyles Street (Nominatim way/329615916), Elmwood, Columbia
endpoints.validation: The cached SC PSC order (scpsc-2014-86-e-lyles-lake-murray-order, p.1 and p.6) names SCE&G's existing 'Lyles 230/115 kV substation in Columbia' in Richland County, next to the Columbia Canal. This is the only 230/115 kV substation in that area. OSM has no name tag. The coordinate now matches the desc-2 batch for the same OSM way.

endpoints.name: Millrace
endpoints.coordinateSource: Nominatim house-number interpolation: 1300 Mohawk Drive on OSM way/12470315, Saluda Terrace, West Columbia, Lexington County (planned substation site; no mapped feature yet)
endpoints.validation: WestMetroNews reports a City of West Columbia announcement: Dominion plans the 'Millrace Substation' on existing company property in the 1300 block of Mohawk Drive, with construction in 2027-2028. That matches the plan's 12/31/2028 in-service date. OSM 115 kV lines (ways 1077742250-1077742252 and 1042448239/185230444) pass within 120-300 m of the site. The point is an interpolated block address, not a surveyed site. The source is local news and was not cached.

projects.notes: endpoints[0..1] = the Dunbar Road – Lyles 115 kV line being rebuilt (A, B). endpoints[2] = the new Millrace tap substation named in the title. All three are within about 9 km of each other in Columbia / West Columbia.

endpoints.name: Williams Street
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/329102047 power=substation substation=distribution voltage=115000 (unnamed), on Williams St (Nominatim way/158973881), The Vista, Columbia
endpoints.validation: OSM has no name. A public Waze listing gives a 'Dominion Energy substation, 1401 Williams St, Columbia', and this is the only 115 kV substation on Williams Street. endpoints.validation: A.M. Williams Station is the DESC/GENCO plant at Bushy Park, Goose Creek, Berkeley County. The switchyard substation is next to the plant, and the name matches.

endpoints.name: McMeekin
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/186840912 power=plant name=McMeekin Station operator=Dominion Energy South Carolina, Inc addr=6055 Bush River Road; the unnamed 115 kV generation switchyard OSM way/185149203 (34.05537,-81.21669) is 60 m away

endpoints.name: Cameron Jct

endpoints.name: Dawson
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/1466128356 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000 (unnamed); cached DESC PSC letter scpsc-2024-91-e-dawson-request p.2 (same point as desc-1)

The plan also rebuilds 8 mi of the parallel Dawson – Faber Place 230 kV toward Mateeba (a Santee Cooper 230 kV substation per the FSAR table, p.10). Mateeba was not located; the nearest named place is Mateeba Gardens, Dorchester County.

endpoints.name: Long Savannah

From there, 115 kV way/1074904633 and 46 kV ways 1074904625/1074904626 continue 3.5 km into this McCormick Substation. The 115/46 kV SPDC way/1074904628 then continues northwest toward Calhoun Falls.

Duplicate key: in the 2024-2028 and 2025-2029 editions '6809 M' was 'St George - Sumter 230kV Tie' (the desc-2 batch). Match this entry only to the 2026-2030 'Modoc – McCormick' title.

endpoints.validation: This is DESC's Stevens Creek hydro station on the Savannah River, the SC–GA border just above Augusta. OSM line 'Ward - Stevens Creek 115kV' starts here, and HIFLD shows nine SCE&G 115 kV lines. The shortest OSM 115 kV path from here to Graniteville is 15.03 mi, matching the plan's 15-mile section.

endpoints.validation: The name matches, and it is the end of 46 kV line way/12139895 from Calhoun County. I rejected the other OSM 'North Substation' (way/185577977, 33.468,-80.786, in Orangeburg city) because it is not on this 46 kV line.

endpoints.validation: The plan names a future Union Pier 115-13.8 kV substation. Union Pier is the SC Ports terminal on the Cooper River in downtown Charleston, which is being redeveloped. The substation's exact site within the tract is not public.

endpoints.validation: The name matches and the operator is DESC. It is 0.74 km north of the Union Pier tract. The plan names it as a possible dedicated feed.

endpoints.validation: HIFLD traces the Faber Place – Bayfront 115 kV line from Faber Place (line 108356, 4.8 mi) to a tap at Maryville, then 4.63 mi to Bayfront. This unnamed substation sits on that line 1.9 mi from Faber Place, just west of the Ashley River in the Northbridge neighborhood. That fits the plan's 'across the Ashley River - N. Bridge Terrace'. OSM has no name tag.

endpoints.validation: The HIFLD 115 kV path from Faber Place ends here. It is 0.44 km from Bayfront hamlet on James Island, Charleston County.

endpoints.validation: The name matches and the operator is DESC. It is in the Cainhoy area of Berkeley County, 0.8 km from Clements Ferry Road (same feature as desc-1).

issuesFixed: desc:6888 was a placeholder (33,-81, 'named-facility'/'confirmed', coordinateSource 'placeholder'), which would have put a fake confirmed point in the data. Replaced it with Okatie (desc-1 feature), McIntosh (Georgia Power OSM way/121624352) and the new Deerfield switching station (hamlet locality, lower-confidence). Added NRC FSAR Table 8.1-1 (cached nrc-vcsummer-fsar-ch8-rev22 p.11, excerpt verified) showing 'Okatie – McIntosh 115' is a DESC–Georgia Power tie.

The researcher's result had no entries for 13 of the batch's 18 items (6809 R, 6809 O, 06076 A, 6808 R, 6877 A, 6869 D, 6809 M, 6809 T, 6810 N, 0167 C-D, 6808 V, 0147 A-I, 06810 F). All were researched and added. Where possible I checked each against the plan's line mileage using OSM or HIFLD: Wateree–Killian 35.1 vs 35 mi; Stevens Creek–Graniteville 15.03 vs 15 mi; VCS2–Ward about 39.4 vs 40 mi; Church Creek–Dawson 16.36 vs 16.6 mi; Calhoun County 9.67 mi from North vs 9.5 mi.
Removed the placeholder unresolved entry and replaced it with the real open items.

desc:6842 Clemson Wind Turbine: the validation cited 1250 Supply St, which Nominatim shows is the Warren Lasch Conservation Center / H.L. Hunley site. clemson.edu gives the Dominion Energy Innovation Center as 1240 Supply St (Nominatim 32.8551,-79.9597), 250 m from the substation. Corrected the text; the match stays lower-confidence because the substation is unnamed.
desc:6842 Coast Guard: confirmed the new campus address (4500 S Hobson Ave, Live 5 News) falls in the OSM USCG polygon. Coordinate kept as locality, lower-confidence.

desc:6864 Millrace: clarified that the coordinate is a Nominatim house-number interpolation on Mohawk Dr (way 12470315), not a mapped address point or substation. Checked that OSM 115 kV lines pass within 120-300 m. Confidence stays confirmed on the strength of the name, operator and date match.

desc:6864 Lyles: harmonized the coordinate to 34.02161,-81.06031 so it matches the same OSM way/185230443 used in desc-2. The researcher's 34.02204,-81.06064 was a different centroid for the same way.
desc:1060A, I, L McMeekin: noted the adjacent unnamed 115 kV generation switchyard (way/185149203, 60 m away). The coordinate is unchanged.

desc:6810 T: checked Cameron Jct OSM node/5211620240; it is power=pole line_management=branch. Recomputed along-line distances: 9.82 mi to St Matthews, 7.81 mi to Orangeburg #1, 7.55 mi to Elloree (the researcher had 8.1).
